integrity: Proof uses exact characteristic-independent determinant and tangency identities plus finite-field spot-checks; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: All primes except 3. Counts concern reduced geometric singular-point supports and prime-field rational point support, not scheme lengths, freeness, or Tjurina numbers. The abstract dual-Hesse incidence type itself is known.
title: The characteristic-two dual-Hesse jump of the Fermat cubic inflection-tangent divisor
